Initial read: the q8_0 quant kernel path changes KV cache layout and runtime attention tiling for small-batch long-tail prompts. On our internal repro (approx. Silverbridge request shape) I can reproduce p99 increase when combining q8_0 with the current attention kernel selector. Hypothesis: a path-selection regression induced an extra recompute on long contexts that amplifies tail latency and increases memory pressure -> decoder retries -> 5xx in some cases.

Short-term fixes:
- Force-disable q8_0 for the hotpath route (immediate)
- Adjust kernel selector to prefer the old attention tiling when sequence length < 256 and batch < 4
- Backport a minimal decoder retry-sane guard (prevents cascade to 5xx)

I can push a patched kernel today but it requires a coordinated rollout and we need to test across canaries. Given customer SLA exposure I'm in favor of immediate traffic failover + rolling rollback to v5.2 for Silverbridge while we prepare a safe q8_0 patch.

Marcus
